name: Hajánek: Bedtime Stories
subtitle: Calm tales and sleep sounds
promotional_text: Ten familiar fairy tales retold as gentle sleep meditations, with rain, sea and lullabies underneath. Now in nine languages. No ads, no account.
description:
Hajánek is an app for the last ten minutes of the day. Your child hears a familiar fairy tale retold as a bedtime meditation: first they settle in and slow their breathing, then walk slowly along the forest path with Little Red Riding Hood, and at the end the characters fall asleep with them. Underneath, the sea, rain or a music box plays softly, and keeps playing for a while after the tale ends.

TALES WITH NOTHING TO BE AFRAID OF
Every tale follows the same calm path of about ten minutes: an introduction (blanket, pillow, breathing in and out), the way into the tale, the story, and a wind-down where the voice slows and softens. The sentences are short, nobody shouts, and your child doesn't have to answer anything.

Everything scary is gone. The wolf eats no one and frightens no one: he is an old, kind wolf who walks Little Red Riding Hood through the forest. No threats, no punishments.

Ten tales:
• Little Red Riding Hood
• Goldenhair, the golden-haired princess (after K. J. Erben)
• Hansel and Gretel
• Snow White
• Sleeping Beauty
• The Three Little Pigs
• Sweet Porridge
• Budulínek and the Little Fox (a Czech tale)
• Smolíček and the Golden Deer (a Czech tale)
• Long, Broad and Sharpsight (a Czech tale)

New tales are added to the catalog and the app downloads them by itself.

NINE LANGUAGES
The app, all the tales and the voice are available in Czech, English, German, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Polish and Slovak. The language follows your phone, and you can change it in Settings.

JUKEBOX: NATURE SOUNDS AND LULLABIES
The jukebox plays without a tale too, all night if you like. Mix up to three layers, each with its own volume.
• Nature sounds: sea, rain on the roof, a little stream, a fireplace, wind in the trees, a night meadow, pink and brown noise
• 14 lullabies: music box, piano, harp, guitar, chimes and dreamy tunes, all slow, with no drums and no singing
• 5 mixes: Beach at Dusk, Forest at Night, Rainy Evening, By the Fireplace, Gentle Noise. You can save your own mix under its own name.
Every sound is in the app and plays offline.

“GOOD NIGHT” RITUAL AND SLEEP TIMER
For the first minute only the background plays, then the tale begins. Afterwards the background plays on for a while and slowly fades out. The timer turns the sound off after 5 to 60 minutes or at the end of the tale, and never cuts it off abruptly.

YOUR PHONE'S VOICE
The tale is read by your phone's own voice in the app's language. It works right away and offline. If the voice is missing, the app shows where to install it (on iPhone, ideally an Enhanced or Premium voice).

DARK FOR THE BEDROOM
The whole app is dark, with no white areas and with large buttons. The player screen dims after a few seconds. The lock screen shows the tale's title and a pause button.

NO ADS, NO ACCOUNT
No ads, no sign-up, no analytics. For children aged about three to eight.
